data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 唱片封面
data.description: 她本来只打算陪你进店，看到一张熟悉的唱片却停下了脚步。她把封面翻到背面，认真看起曲目。
data.action: 从唱片架抽出一张唱片
data.promptProse: While browsing through weathered wooden record bins in a cozy music shop, Fiammetta stops, her attention captured by the distinct, eye-catching cover of an old vinyl record. She turns the sleeve to examine the tracklist, with rows of stacked vinyl records, warm amber Edison bulbs, and acoustic soundproofing panels framing the scene in a tranquil, music-filled atmosphere.
